name: TweenHandle
src_typeComment: One running tween's state — a plain C# class (not a MonoBehaviour), driven centrally by TweenRunner rather than needing a GameObject/Update per tween. Reuses Toolkit.MathUtilities.EasingFunctions for the actual curve math instead of duplicating it. Returned by every Tween.* factory method so callers can Kill()/Pause() a specific tween later (e.g. cancel a fade if a new one starts before the old one finishes).

src_members.sig: public bool IsComplete { get; private set; }
src_members.name: IsComplete
Tick
src_members.comment: Returns true once this tween is fully done and should be removed from the runner. Public (not internal) specifically so a self-test can drive a tween with exact, known time increments instead of needing Play mode — same reasoning as this toolkit's other public Tick()-style test hooks.

src_members.name: Kill
src_members.comment: Stops the tween immediately. callOnComplete lets a caller distinguish "cancelled early" (default, no callback) from "treat this as finished" (e.g. snapping a UI fade straight to its end state).
